contract.acceptance_criteria: Correct quantified set-family arguments and literal Lean theorem interfaces; precise separation of external I27, local conditional global theorem, unconditional two-star theorem and exploratory diagnostics; primary-source attribution with bounded novelty scope; no unresolved major issue or required revision; actual twelve contexts each ten synchronous rounds plus separate Chief Alpha Beta same-hash final audits.
assumptions: Finite families of distinct four-element sets; three distinct petals; empty core allowed
External I27 used only for ordinary mathematical corollary
Lean logical foundation propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound
contract.audience: Researchers in extremal combinatorics and proof assistants
constraints: No unconditional local Lean G80 claim
No all-rank sunflower resolution or exhaustive global priority claim
Review admitted after actual A/B exclusions, per review-admission.json
No clean complete-toolchain rebuild claim unless actual evidence supports it
deliverables: Separate machine-readable review and verification bundle
contract.exclusion: Unaudited diagnostic promotion, unperformed source access, unsupported priority or certification claims
contract.field: Extremal set theory and formal verification
contract.inclusion: Pinned primary-source content, literal Lean roots, source and output receipts, reproducible calculations and retained failed attempts
methods: Lean elaboration and fail-closed transitive axiom audit
contract.question: Do the actual-family exclusions of Profiles A and B prove I(27) implies G(80), with unconditional independent-twenty-star bound eighty and an accurately delimited ordinary corollary using externally established I(27)?
contract.resource_budget: Twelve persistent contexts, at most two reviewers active concurrently, ten full synchronous phases plus separate final audits; continue substantive revisions if needed.
contract.topic: Excluding both eighty-one-member boundary profiles in rank-four sunflower-free families

limitations: Actual separate collaboration contexts in one orchestration environment; model/provider details unavailable; organizational independence not established
Local unsigned hashes and declared actual tool provenance; no third-party authentication or independent human certification
Bounded primary-source and accessible text comparison; no exhaustive novelty or originality claim
